explication: Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a cross-platform roguelike dungeon crawler. At runtime, the game accepts player input, runs a scene-driven game, and maintains dungeon state involving the hero, enemies, items, and level effects; saved runs and progression support continued play. The tree also shows rendering/input foundations and optional news/update services. Some major gameplay modules are visible only in the tree, so their internal links are left unverified rather than inferred as call chains.
